title: Announcing NASA Aeronautics’ new Flight Log Experience!
description: Announcing NASA Aeronautics’ new Flight Log experience! Visit the Aeronautics Flight Log to get boarding passes to upcoming flights, create and build your own flight log, earn virtual NASA mission patches, and learn about NASA Aeronautics’ quest to fly faster, quieter, and more sustainably. Sign up today and let’s fly! Your name will “Fly with Us” on future X-planes and so much more!  www.nasa.gov/flightlog
keywords: aeronautics, ARMD, NASA, flight log, AFRC, Nils Larson, test pilot, STEM
via: the NASA Image and Video Library
